args.lesson: Bounded STOP. Worked: checking capability first (Rscript absent, no pandas) and reading categories.json before searching showed quickly that the channel lacks a paid-work category. Three dated searches (paid, freelance, hire) found 0 buyer requests; the only hit was an excluded job posting. Failed: Q&A help forums (OSM, Ghost, Posit) keep yielding help questions or employment ads, not paid project requests. Next time: before choosing a help forum as a buyer channel, check that it has a jobs/marketplace category. Do not pick request-fulfillment tasks in a language runtime the sandbox lacks. The result is scoped to this channel and is not evidence of zero demand elsewhere.
